violations.text: The floor behind front counter area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

Tamales were observed held at (105) degrees Fahrenheit. PIC voluntary discarded tamales at time of inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Containers of mixed veggies were observed held at (58) degrees Fahrenheit. PIC voluntarily disposed of mixed veggies containers at time of inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Foods were observed not marked with the date of preparation in the following locations: -Kitchen cooler -W/I cooler -Front sliding door cooler Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Queso, ice creams packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Sliding door cooler located behind front desk area was not in good repair (not holding adequate ambient temperature). Observed temperature between 49-51 degrees Fahrenheit. PIC instructed not to store TCS foods in unit until unit is service/adjustment and is maintaining 41 degrees Fahrenheit and below temperature. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
The floor behind front counter area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of black residue and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Unit taken out service to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils are not stored inverted and must not be stored directly on the floor. PIC informed to reclean and sanitize equipment and store properly. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (mixer) have an accumulation of food residue and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the (kitchen) mixer area do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2026
